definitions.explanation: Items made from processed animal hide (leather), such as bags, wallets, belts, shoes, and jackets.

examples.japanese: {革製品|かわせいひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Taking care of leather goods is important.

examples.japanese: ⟦イタリア→イタリア：19423_itaria⟧⟦{製|せい}→〜製：02001_sei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{革製品|かわせいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought Italian leather goods as souvenirs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧{革製品|かわせいひん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}い{込|こ}む→使い込む：07876_tsukaikomu⟧ほど⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Quality leather goods develop more character the more you use them.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧ (leather) and ⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧ (product, manufactured goods). The kanji ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧ specifically means processed animal hide (leather), as opposed to ⟦{皮|かわ}→皮：02187_kawa⟧ which refers to raw skin or hide.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {革製品|かわせいひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手入|てい}れ→手入れ：07178_teire⟧: leather care
- {革製品|かわせいひん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧: leather repair
- ⟦{本革|ほんがわ}→本革：16787_hongawa⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: genuine leather products

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧: leather — the material itself
- ⟦{皮革|ひかく}→皮革：28433_hikaku⟧: leather and hides — a more formal/technical term covering both raw and processed materials
- ⟦{合成皮革|ごうせいひかく}→合成皮革：23705_gouseihikaku⟧: synthetic leather, faux leather — imitation leather made from synthetic materials
- ⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: product — also used in other compounds like ⟦{乳製品|にゅうせいひん}→乳製品：05882_nyuuseihin⟧ (dairy products)
